display_name: Hybrid 全置信样本辅助权重对照
description: 四种配置、三种子比较全置信 Hybrid 辅助权重 0.25 与 0.5，并配对既有全权重。
authorization: 2026-11-13 用户将优化目标更改为 Hybrid，要求所有通过置信度的伪标签参与辅助训练。

code.commit: actual committed release identity in runtime.json

data.dataset: original receiver split 2, ten-class, 1%-labeled and six-source-receiver

roles.L_s: complete original labeled role for each configuration

data.train_ratio: original per-configuration roles; no source holdout
data.validation_ref: existing data roles; Phase2 capsule not applicable
data.support_query_ref: per-row frozen seven-view prediction then independent truth-last scoring
data.leo_config_ref: original six practical scenario views, identical physical IDs per matched row

permissions.query_use: frozen direct prediction then independent truth-last
permissions.claim_scope: previously exposed test sets; exploratory comparison without target feedback into training

checkpoint.initialization: same-setting same-seed original full-L Tri E20, then own E10+E20
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: matching original full-source same-seed E20; no held-out L or target ancestry
checkpoint.selection_rule: all 30 fixed rows, final E50; no target-driven checkpoint selection

execution.gpu_policy: single shared owner; GPU 7 total max 4 and other cards max 6, includes other users and memory reservations
execution.stop_rule: Systemic technical failure stops new dispatch for the affected queue; preserve other healthy workers and outputs

expected_artifacts: real-checkpoint no-query smoke per weight and setting
24 direct seven-view predictions and independent truth-last scores
matched ordinary PL, original Hybrid and full-weight confidence Hybrid comparisons

notes: Every confidence-accepted source U packet is routed into Hybrid auxiliary training, including the original non-physical half; branch votes and prototype loss are absent.
If only one accepted pseudo-class occurs, a same-packet cosine term substitutes for unavailable contrastive negatives.
The existing physical strength taper is retained; expanded physical routing also changes the original mixed U path.
Prior ordinary PL and original Hybrid controls are reused by same setting and seed.
Previously exposed target tests imply exploratory results; fixed matrix and training do not depend on target scores.
The fixed 0.25 and 0.5 coefficients scale only the additional Hybrid fusion/branch auxiliary loss; all confidence-accepted U remain selected.
The 1.0 confidence-only Hybrid is the already running 20261113-phase1-pamf-hybrid-confidence-m30-r01, reused by setting and seed.
Full-weight scores never block reduced-weight training or testing; incomplete comparisons are recorded as pending.
